title: Moroccan Chicken Stir Fry
description: A flavorful and spicy chicken stir fry with the warm and aromatic flavors of Morocco. Serve with steamed vegetables and couscous for a delicious and healthy meal.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the diced onion and bell pepper and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Stir in the Moroccan spice blend and lemon juice.
Serve hot over steamed vegetables and couscous.
